title: Exclude mixed P104 four-MOVE recharts (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** Two independent contact walks exhausted 76,461 events and agree on all 374 mixed public/owned ADDs and 1,496 neighboring contact slots. The scope requires each operand’s immediately preceding and following literal contact to be its own paid MOVE, so the common chart can change while all four transport clocks stay fixed. Every mixed ADD lacks at least one required MOVE, even before excluding the 65 protected or main/hosted cases. There are zero price/geometry variants, survivors, or unresolved keys.

The directed price was saved first. It grants a favorable example near 0.06448459292623317 raw and bounds one edit by about 0.37412316129256057 raw. With two owned MOVEs per disjoint edit, the relaxed 47-MOVE stock gives at most 23 disjoint edits and about 8.604832709728893 raw total, with all ancillary work free. Compatible savings in the exact literal scope are zero.

## Task, overlap and validation

Round 67 of [Discussion #7111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111). The exact tested word is #7314 at 9d0119eb12fbd9fa534b48cd37b68e7099757b91, with the unchanged #7113 caller. #7297 holds mixed contacts fixed, #7122 preserves owned-involved contacts, and #7334 changes a different helper-319 block. The branch retains the #7257 replay prerequisites.

~~~sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-mixed-four-move-rechart-bound/replay.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-mixed-four-move-rechart-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-mixed-four-move-rechart-bound --check-modes --check-source-history
~~~

All four receipt hashes, both mutation controls, registered replay, committed bytes/modes/source history, Git-free export and six navigation tests passed locally. A connected mixed component with several scalar contacts or a changed contact schedule remains open.
